name: channels
title: Channels
summary: Org members talk in public, private and forum channels, direct and group messages, with threads, mentions, reactions, pins, saved items, search and live delivery.

env.name: CHANNELS_MESSAGE_MAX_CHARS
env.doc: Longest message accepted, in characters (at least 100).

env.name: CHANNELS_EDIT_WINDOW
env.doc: How long after sending a message its sender can edit it (Go duration; 0 = no limit).

env.name: CHANNELS_MESSAGES_PER_MINUTE
env.doc: Messages one person can send per minute across all channels (the agent post tool counts too).

env.name: CHANNELS_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB
env.doc: Largest file a message can carry, in MB.

env.name: CHANNELS_DEFAULT_CHANNELS
env.doc: Comma-separated channels created in a new workspace that every org member joins once (the first one receives org-wide announcements).

env.name: CHANNELS_MENTION_ALL_MAX_MEMBERS
env.doc: Above this many members (and in default channels) only org owners and admins can use @channel and @here.

stitch: Org permissions: the defaults (any member creates channels; owners, admins and a channel's admins archive, edit and remove; @channel/@here for admins anywhere, members in small non-default channels) live in channels.DefaultPermission. Replace them with channels.SetPermissionCheck(func(ctx, q, req channels.PermissionRequest) (bool, error)), e.g. the access feature's permission check, falling back to DefaultPermission.
@group mentions: channels.SetGroupResolver(r) with SearchGroups + GroupMembers (e.g. the access feature's teams). Without it @groups are off.
Calls: channels.SetCallStarter(func(ctx, caller, target channels.CallTarget) (path string, err error)) shows Start call in channel and DM headers (e.g. the calls feature).
Announcements from other features: channels.PostBotMessage(ctx, channelID, channels.BotMessage{BotName, Text, ThreadRootID}); channels.DefaultChannel(ctx, orgID) finds #general.
Presence visibility: with orgs, presence.SetVisibilityPolicy(presence.SharedGroupPolicy("org_members", "org_id", "user_id")) so presence dots follow org membership.

Do Not Disturb: channels registers notifications.AddDeliveryFilter("presence.dnd", ...) so pushes and emails are held app-wide while it is on; remove that line from channels.New if the app wants DND to cover channels only.

Name the section (Channels, Chat, Messages) in nav copy and decide its place: it is a nav entry and a mobile tab. Workspaces follow the active org (useActiveOrg); people in no org see the empty state that links to Settings → Organizations.
Add the push-preview line to the privacy policy: message text appears in notifications.
If you change CHANNELS_ATTACHMENT_MAX_MB, the clients read the limit from the workspace config; nothing else to change.
